text:
nina-partners: Heads up — GigaRetail's PO inbound via GCP Marketplace failed ack with a namespace + taxblock error. They need provisioning turned on but Marketplace won't accept the PO.

diego-sales: Any error details? Customer is on a tight promo timeline.

nina-partners: From the marketplace webhook:
```
HTTP 422
error: po_validation_failed
details: Element 'TaxDetails' missing in namespace 'urn:gcp:po:v2'
notes: received namespace 'urn:gcp:po' (v1)
```
GigaRetail's procurement system emits the older namespace and doesn't include TaxDetails node (they send tax via separate field).

kim-finance: GCP requires TaxDetails for VAT/trade-tax reconciliation. We can't book revenue without tax metadata. Can't accept POs without it unless we have an attestation.

raj-marketplace-ops: The portal rejects any XML that doesn't match v2 schema. We can file an exception but it needs approval from GCP-SellerSupport. I've started an internal escalation.

gcp-integration-bot: Ticket GCP-MKT-9031 created: "PO schema mismatch: urn:gcp:po vs urn:gcp:po:v2; missing TaxDetails". Assigned to jlee@gcp-support. ETA 36h.

nina-partners: Customer says they can update their system but it will take 3 business days. They asked if we can map the tax info from their supplemental file into TaxDetails on our ingest flow.

kim-finance: We will only accept a mapping if (1) the original PO is preserved, (2) the mapping is auditable, and (3) the buyer sends an email attesting that the attached TaxSummary is authoritative for this PO.

tara-legal: Also saw a contract-level issue: their PO includes a non-standard refund clause (refund_within_120_days) which conflicts with our Marketplace T&Cs. Legal needs a signed confirmation to override.

diego-sales: Can we do a dual-track: (A) temporary intake via internal billing portal with Finance approval + buyer attestation, (B) parallel GCP support request to get the portal to accept the corrected XML so records line up? Customer wants A to go live.

raj-marketplace-ops: We can accept temporary intake but need finance and legal sign-off. If we do internal intake, we'll attach the original payload and the submitted TaxSummary, and create a reconciliation ticket so marketplace records are updated when GCP unblocks.

kim-finance: Fine with manual intake if buyer sends attestation email and includes tax ID (VAT/GST) and jurisdiction. Please include finance ref "GCP-9031" on any ledger entries.

tara-legal: I'll draft a short confirmation template acknowledging the refund clause conflict and stating that acceptance is limited to provisioning only (no T&C amendment). Sender must be an authorized procurement contact.

diego-sales: I'll get GigaRetail PM to sign the attestation and confirm procurement contact. Pushing for the email now.

nina-partners: Follow-up: customer just replied that procurement can send the attestation in ~2 hours. I've attached our attestation checklist to the thread.

gcp-integration-bot: Update: GCP ticket jlee@gcp-support acknowledged. Requested sample v2 XML to validate.

raj-marketplace-ops: Action items: (1) @diego-sales collect buyer attestation email + tax details, (2) @tara-legal share confirmation template, (3) @kim-finance prep manual intake checklist, (4) @nina-partners hold until attestation received then coordinate manual entry. I'll follow up on GCP ticket and post updates.

diego-sales: Copy — working this now. Will post attestation here when I have it.

nina-partners: Thanks all — keeping this open until GCP accepts the v2 XML or manual intake completes.
